notes: Fixed tracker detail text still blowing out row height on multi-step findings. 5.6.41's fix relied on CSS -webkit-line-clamp, confirmed live to not reliably apply inside a table cell -- a finding with several remediation steps rendered completely unclamped. Replaced with JS-based truncation to a fixed character length (guaranteed correct, doesn't depend on CSS layout behavior that can silently fail), with full text still available via hover tooltip. Also found and fixed: some tracked items imported months ago captured KB-article text already corrupted by a lossy errors='replace' decode somewhere upstream in an older, since-fixed code path -- the exact same live finding now enriches with clean text, confirming the root cause is already resolved, but the previously-captured text was permanently unrecoverable. Added a display-time sanitizer that strips the resulting replacement characters so old corrupted entries read cleanly. Verified live against the real corrupted item reported.
